d: Jet black hair falls to the floor in extremely long, straight locks with blunt-cut bangs and a central parting. Sharp, narrow eyes are a vivid light blue, set in a mature face of an adult. The build is slender with a large bust, dressed in a revealing black and gold outfit consisting of a plunging neckline bodice, sheer black tights, and a long, flowing white and light-blue cape. A gold headpiece secures a white veil, and the figure holds a massive, ornate black and gold mechanical musical instrument.
